===== postgres/marts.fct_events/load.by_key.sql =====
-- dbdatabuild rendered load operation. Generated by `render --write`; do not edit.
-- model:           marts.fct_events
-- operation:       by_key
-- connection:      postgres
-- strategy:        merge_by_key
-- definition hash: f15148c08525742c57b08b6f8ac0a41c89993eeab026ec430b20f32256399de2
-- parameters:      none
BEGIN;
CREATE TEMP TABLE ddb_stage AS
WITH ddb_body AS (SELECT e.event_id, e.event_ts, e.seq, e.payload FROM staging.events AS e)
SELECT "event_id", "event_ts", "seq", "payload" FROM ddb_body;
MERGE INTO "marts"."fct_events" AS tgt USING ddb_stage AS src ON (tgt."event_id" = src."event_id")
WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET "event_ts" = src."event_ts", "seq" = src."seq", "payload" = src."payload"
WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT ("event_id", "event_ts", "seq", "payload") VALUES (src."event_id", src."event_ts", src."seq", src."payload");
DROP TABLE ddb_stage;
COMMIT;

===== postgres/marts.fct_events/load.daily.resolve.sql =====
-- dbdatabuild resolver for a rendered load operation. Generated by `render --write`; do not edit.
-- model:           marts.fct_events
-- operation:       daily
-- connection:      postgres
-- strategy:        watermark_append
-- definition hash: f15148c08525742c57b08b6f8ac0a41c89993eeab026ec430b20f32256399de2
-- parameters:      @watermark (TIMESTAMP, resolver, overridable)
SELECT COALESCE(MAX("event_ts") - INTERVAL '6 hours', CAST('2020-01-01 00:00:00' AS TIMESTAMP)) FROM "marts"."fct_events";

===== postgres/marts.fct_events/load.daily.sql =====
-- dbdatabuild rendered load operation. Generated by `render --write`; do not edit.
-- model:           marts.fct_events
-- operation:       daily
-- connection:      postgres
-- strategy:        watermark_append
-- definition hash: f15148c08525742c57b08b6f8ac0a41c89993eeab026ec430b20f32256399de2
-- parameters:      @watermark (TIMESTAMP, resolver, overridable)
BEGIN;
CREATE TEMP TABLE ddb_stage AS
WITH ddb_body AS (SELECT e.event_id, e.event_ts, e.seq, e.payload FROM staging.events AS e)
SELECT "event_id", "event_ts", "seq", "payload" FROM ddb_body WHERE ddb_body."event_ts" >= @watermark;
DELETE FROM "marts"."fct_events" WHERE "event_ts" >= @watermark;
INSERT INTO "marts"."fct_events" ("event_id", "event_ts", "seq", "payload")
SELECT "event_id", "event_ts", "seq", "payload" FROM ddb_stage;
DROP TABLE ddb_stage;
COMMIT;

===== postgres/marts.fct_events/load.reload_period.sql =====
-- dbdatabuild rendered load operation. Generated by `render --write`; do not edit.
-- model:           marts.fct_events
-- operation:       reload_period
-- connection:      postgres
-- strategy:        delete_insert_by_range
-- definition hash: f15148c08525742c57b08b6f8ac0a41c89993eeab026ec430b20f32256399de2
-- parameters:      @start (TIMESTAMP, runtime), @end (TIMESTAMP, runtime, max_span 400 days)
BEGIN;
CREATE TEMP TABLE ddb_stage AS
WITH ddb_body AS (SELECT e.event_id, e.event_ts, e.seq, e.payload FROM staging.events AS e)
SELECT "event_id", "event_ts", "seq", "payload" FROM ddb_body WHERE ddb_body."event_ts" >= @start AND ddb_body."event_ts" < @end;
DELETE FROM "marts"."fct_events" WHERE "event_ts" >= @start AND "event_ts" < @end;
INSERT INTO "marts"."fct_events" ("event_id", "event_ts", "seq", "payload")
SELECT "event_id", "event_ts", "seq", "payload" FROM ddb_stage;
DROP TABLE ddb_stage;
COMMIT;

===== postgres/marts.fct_events/load.replace_keys.sql =====
-- dbdatabuild rendered load operation. Generated by `render --write`; do not edit.
-- model:           marts.fct_events
-- operation:       replace_keys
-- connection:      postgres
-- strategy:        delete_insert_by_key
-- definition hash: f15148c08525742c57b08b6f8ac0a41c89993eeab026ec430b20f32256399de2
-- parameters:      none
BEGIN;
CREATE TEMP TABLE ddb_stage AS
WITH ddb_body AS (SELECT e.event_id, e.event_ts, e.seq, e.payload FROM staging.events AS e)
SELECT "event_id", "event_ts", "seq", "payload" FROM ddb_body;
DELETE FROM "marts"."fct_events" AS tgt WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM ddb_stage AS src WHERE src."event_id" = tgt."event_id");
INSERT INTO "marts"."fct_events" ("event_id", "event_ts", "seq", "payload")
SELECT "event_id", "event_ts", "seq", "payload" FROM ddb_stage;
DROP TABLE ddb_stage;
COMMIT;
